import sys, json

# The tool families this agent offers (R-SA-18): `tools_enabled` names them,
# by family (`web` is web_fetch and web_search), and the default is none. The
# menu the collector asks `./tools` for loses every tool of a family nobody
# enabled, and a call of such a tool never reaches `./tools`: it is not the
# agent's own, so it goes on to the door like every name the agent does not
# serve -- the door owns the turn's client menu, and a caller's `bash` while
# the agent's bash family is off is the caller's call (OR-AG-47). Each menu
# tick also tells the door which families are enabled (lane `tools_enabled`),
# so the door keeps a client tool whose own family is off. Names that are no
# family's (memory_recall, history_*) pass untouched: the agent's own core
# tools are always there.

doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
P = doc.get("params") or {}
body = doc.get("body") or {}
hop = ((doc.get("envelope") or {}).get("header") or {}).get("hop") or {}
# The shipped default, so a bare run gates exactly like the shipped cell.
FAMILIES = {"bash": ["bash"], "file": ["file"], "edit": ["edit"],
            "web": ["web_fetch", "web_search"], "weather": ["weather"]}
families = P.get("tool_families") or FAMILIES
enabled = {str(f) for f in (P.get("tools_enabled") or []) if isinstance(f, str)}
family_of = {}
for fam, names in families.items():
    for n in names or []:
        family_of[str(n)] = str(fam)


def allowed(name):
    fam = family_of.get(name)
    return fam is None or fam in enabled


route = str(hop.get("route", ""))
out = []
if route == "schemas":
    asked = body.get("tools")
    msg = dict(body)
    if isinstance(asked, list):
        msg["tools"] = [n for n in asked if not isinstance(n, str) or allowed(n)]
    msg.setdefault("messages", [])
    msg["header"] = dict(hop, route="in_schemas")
    on = sorted(enabled)
    out = [msg, {"header": {"route": "tools_enabled", "tools_enabled": json.dumps(on)},
                 "tools_enabled": on, "messages": []}]
elif route == "tool":
    name = str(hop.get("tool_name") or "")
    if allowed(name):
        msg = dict(body)
        msg.setdefault("messages", [])
        msg["header"] = dict(hop, route="tool_call")
        out = [msg]
    else:
        # Not the agent's own tool: to the door, as the dispatcher would have
        # sent a name it has no cell for.
        msg = dict(body)
        msg.setdefault("messages", [])
        msg["header"] = dict(hop, route="tool")
        out = [msg]
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))

tools_enabled.description: the own tool families on offer; none by default

tool_families.description: family -> the tool names it folds (`web` is web_fetch and web_search)
